name: bodyweight bench squat
description: A squat down to a bench and back up. The bench gives you a depth target and builds leg strength with control.
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower.
Lightly touch the bench with your glutes without dropping onto it.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
